disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件运行时源码中的敏感路径读取模式（凭据文件、SSH 私钥、云凭据、钱包助记词等）。未发现任何对凭据文件的读取、枚举或外发逻辑；插件只读取工作区内 .ai-novel 项目目录的小说资产文件。
checked_items.en: Checked the plugin runtime source for sensitive path read patterns (credential files, SSH private keys, cloud credentials, wallet mnemonics, etc.). No logic for reading, enumerating, or exfiltrating credential files was found; the plugin only reads novel asset files under the `.ai-novel` project directory within the workspace.

checked_items.zh: 核查了插件全部运行时源码（novel-project.ts、agent.ts、index.ts、context-window.ts 等），确认文件访问被约束在会话工作区根内并做了符号链接与路径逃逸防护，未触及用户凭据面。
checked_items.en: Reviewed all runtime source of the plugin (`novel-project.ts`, `agent.ts`, `index.ts`, `context-window.ts`, etc.), confirmed that file access is confined within the session workspace root and includes symlink and path traversal protections, and does not touch the user credential surface.

evidence.zh: 插件运行时源码中没有任何凭据文件读取操作。读取面仅限工作区内的 .ai-novel 小说项目文件（由 novel-project.ts 限定根目录、拒绝符号链接），不访问用户凭据或系统敏感路径。
evidence.en: There is no credential file read operation in the plugin runtime source. The read surface is limited to `.ai-novel` novel project files within the workspace (with root directory restricted and symlinks rejected by `novel-project.ts`), and does not access user credentials or system sensitive paths.

checked_items.en: Reviewed the description texts of the two registered tools (`novel_read`, `novel_apply_change`), the preset system prompt (`presets/ai-novel-writer/agent.cordis.yml`), and the prompts generated by the client workbench. All are functional writing instructions with no wording for instruction override, system message spoofing, remote instruction loading, or approval bypass.

checked_items.zh: 检查了 README 与安装文档全文，未发现诱导安装、诱导改写配置、诱导放权或伪造权威的文本；文档是对官方 DSH 安装流程的中立调研记录。
checked_items.en: Checked the full text of the README and installation documentation. No text inducing installation, inducing config modification, inducing delegation of privileges, or forging authority was found; the documentation is a neutral research record of the official DSH installation process.

checked_items.zh: 审查了客户端对模型的提示构造（workbench-store.ts、asset-editor.ts），提示词为确定性结构，要求先读后改、等待原生审批，未发现任何注入或越权指令。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the client's prompt construction for the model (`workbench-store.ts`, `asset-editor.ts`). The prompts follow a deterministic structure, require reading before modifying, and wait for native approval. No injection or privilege-escalation instructions were found.

evidence.zh: 工具描述与系统提示经语义审查：只描述小说读取与单资产修改的用法，并要求原生用户审批；无隐藏意图、无凭据读取诱导。
evidence.en: Tool descriptions and system prompts were reviewed semantically: they only describe novel reading and single-asset modification usage, and require native user approval; no hidden intent, no inducement to read credentials.

evidence.zh: 插件文本面（工具描述、预设提示、客户端提示、文档）无任何诱导模型执行插件安装、改写配置或放开权限的措辞；预设安装由用户在工作台显式触发并经宿主 loopback 通道执行。
evidence.en: The plugin text surface (tool descriptions, preset prompts, client prompts, documentation) contains no wording that induces the model to perform plugin installation, modify configuration, or expand privileges; preset installation is explicitly triggered by the user in the workbench and executed via the host loopback channel.

checked_items.zh: 逐条裁决静态扫描命中【DG-R3-57】：键盘监听/剪贴板命中 15 处——插件客户端 context-view.tsx 的 keydown 为抽屉焦点圈（合法无障碍行为）；其余命中全部位于 Electron 宿主应用（src/App.tsx、各对话框/菜单/编辑器组件），为键盘快捷键与复制按钮（navigator.clipboard.writeText 均为用户点击触发的复制操作）。插件客户端无键盘记录、无剪贴板窃取、无 credentials.set 特权调用，不产生 finding。

checked_items.zh: 逐条裁决静态扫描命中【DG-R3-59】：仓库内 6 个 GitHub Actions 工作流为桌面应用与插件的 CI/发布/云构建/更新 E2E 流程，运行在 GitHub 基础设施而非 dsh 宿主执行面，且不随插件安装包分发；属工程惯例（拉请求触发、workflow_dispatch 手动触发、contents: read 最小权限），按规则排除，不产生 finding。
checked_items.en: Adjudicated static scan hit 【DG-R3-59】 one by one: the 6 GitHub Actions workflows in the repository are CI/release/cloud-build/update E2E processes for the desktop app and the plugin. checked_items.zh: 确认插件运行时源码（src/）中无 eval、动态函数构造、子进程调用等危险执行模式；文件写入走宿主提供的原子写原语并带路径包含、符号链接拒绝与大小上限。

evidence.zh: 逐一检查了 shipped 的 YAML 文件：cordis.patch.yml 只有 insert 条目，presets 的 agent.cordis.yml 与 preset.yml 为纯声明式合成配置，均无动态脚本标量。所有动态脚本标量命中只出现在测试夹具与发布脚本（tests/fixtures、scripts/qualify-release.mjs），不进入安装包。

Client bundle review: the only keyboard listener is a drawer focus trap (legitimate UI behavior), no clipboard access, no privileged `credentials.set` RPC; the client only calls the loopback `/ai-novel` read-only and preset-installation endpoints.

evidence.zh: 插件不启动 Web 服务或监听端口；其 RPC 端点以 loopback 权限挂载在宿主的既有连接基础设施上，不新增本机无认证网络入口。

limits.en: The audit focuses on the `plugins/dsh-ai-novel-writer/` directory.
